question.text: For a buyback exceeding Rs.100 crore, what is the escrow deposit requirement?

answer.text: 25% of the first Rs.100 crore plus 10% of the amount exceeding Rs.100 crore

explanation.text: The Logic: The escrow requirement for a buyback is structured in slabs as stated in the workbook: 25% on the consideration up to Rs.100 crore and 10% on the amount exceeding Rs.100 crore. The Trap: Candidates may apply a flat 25% rate to the entire amount, which overstates the escrow for buybacks larger than Rs.100 crore. The slab structure must be applied. Note: Apply 25% to the first Rs.100 crore (= Rs.25 crore) and 10% to the portion above Rs.100 crore, then add them together.
